Results.ReviewText: We bought this BBQ because we were downsizing and it seemed to have all the bells and whistles in a compact package, including rotisserie possibility. The two fold down side trays are a space saver. We also like the fact that it has a mostly closed in lower cupboard for the gas tank so that it is pleasing to the eye and takes up little space.  Two nice features are brakes on the wheels (which for us is a bonus because of wind problems on our deck and the fact that it is a comparatively light BBQ) as well as having a gauge which measures the fullness of the gas tank.

Results.ReviewText: I originally purchased my Spirit E 210 in early Spring of 2013, for approx. 400.00, I have cooked on this grill 365 for 6 years. I replaced the enameled cast grates and flavorizor bars last fall after 5.5 years but the burner assembly is still going strong. The grill has been used weekly 365 and always fires on the first click! Cooking on this grill with the high heat and indirect fire box design and simple 2 burner control has proven successful from everything from steaks, chops, ribs and veggies. My only issue was that after short 6 years of the grill sitting outside on our deck, the caster base completely rusted and fell off the body when I went to move the grill to give it a good summer season pre clean to get rid of the winter and wet spring gunk. The base will always be the most exposed (catching the snow/rain) where the cover leaves a little exposure, but I can easily still argue that I got 2x the life out compared to the 2-3 “big box” brand grills I owned previously and the grill box is still in great shape. Now keep in mind this grill gets used frequently sometimes daily in the summer and my maintenance program and cleaning consists of a soft nylon scrub brush and sponge + garden hose with dish soap on the exterior 3-4 times a year and it “usually” stored under a cover ½ the year in-between cooks in the very sloppy late fall and winter months in NE Ohio. The interior gets cleaned with a plastic putty knife 2-3 times a season after lots of marinade or bbq cooking. I loved this grill and almost tossed it last week after the base disintegrated. I reached out to customer service and ordered a replacement base and side panels and for less that ½ the price of a new grill and a few hours replacing the parts (same amount of time of building a new grill), I am pleased that I am up and grilling again. I am optomistic and hopefully will get another 3-5 years of grilling out of my “partly new” Weber at this point. Customer Service (available on Sunday on a holiday weekend) was awesome and product quality is top notch! I also have a 22” kettle grill that is at a minimum of 25 years “new” and still is my go to for smoking using the classic snake method and wood fired grilling and pizza cooking with great success!
Results.Title: The Best Grill I Have Owned

I have never had a gril this poor for staying hot.  As a result, you put your steaks or burgers, or whatever else on the grill, but you can only get them seared on one side. It tkes forever to heat up again. Weber usually makes great grills like the Genesis, but this one is terrible.

Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.
